+from fastapi import FastAPI, Header
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@app.get("/")
+async def read_header(my_header: str = Header(None)):
+    return {"my_header": my_header}
+
+@app.get("/disabled")
+async def read_header_disabled(my_header: str = Header(None, convert_underscores=False)):
+    return {"my_header": my_header}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_underscore_header():
+    # Default convert_underscores=True
+    # Should NOT accept my_header, only my-header
+    response = client.get("/", headers={"my_header": "value1"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header (default): {response.json()}")
+    
+    response = client.get("/", headers={"my-header": "value2"})
+    print(f"Request with my-header (default): {response.json()}")
+
+def test_underscore_header_disabled():
+    # convert_underscores=False
+    # Should accept my_header
+    response = client.get("/disabled", headers={"my_header": "value3"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header (disabled): {response.json()}")
+    
+    response = client.get("/disabled", headers={"my-header": "value4"})
+    print(f"Request with my-header (disabled): {response.json()}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_underscore_header()
+    test_underscore_header_disabled()

+from fastapi import FastAPI, Header
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@app.get("/alias")
+async def read_header_alias(my_header: str = Header(None, alias="my_header")):
+    return {"my_header": my_header}
+
+@app.get("/alias_diff")
+async def read_header_alias_diff(something: str = Header(None, alias="my_header")):
+    return {"something": something}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_alias_header():
+    # alias="my_header", convert_underscores=True (default)
+    # field.name is "my_header", alias is "my_header". 
+    # In request_params_to_args, alias == field.name is True, so it becomes "my-header".
+    # Should NOT accept my_header, only my-header
+    response = client.get("/alias", headers={"my_header": "value5"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header (alias=name, default): {response.json()}")
+    
+    response = client.get("/alias", headers={"my-header": "value6"})
+    print(f"Request with my-header (alias=name, default): {response.json()}")
+
+def test_alias_diff_header():
+    # alias="my_header", convert_underscores=True (default)
+    # field.name is "something", alias is "my_header".
+    # In request_params_to_args, alias == field.name is False, so it remains "my_header".
+    # This SHOULD NOT accept my_header, but it probably will.
+    response = client.get("/alias_diff", headers={"my_header": "value7"})
+    print(f"Request with my_header (alias!=name, default): {response.json()}")
+    
+    response = client.get("/alias_diff", headers={"my-header": "value8"})
+    print(f"Request with my-header (alias!=name, default): {response.json()}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_alias_header()
+    test_alias_diff_header()
